text: Ɓen yedduɓe Alla, golle maɓɓe ɗe ɓe golli ɗen, ɗe maraa baraaji, ko yeru merere wonnde e hollaande ɗonɗaaɗo on no yi'a nde o sikka ko nde ndiyam, o yaha e mayre haa si o hewtii o daroo e hoore mayre o heɓataa ndiyam, ko wano nii yedduɗo on himo sikka wonnde golle makko ɗen ɗe nafay mo, haa si o maayii o immintinaama hara o heɓatah baraaji golle ɗen. O tawa Joomi makko yeeso makko O huuɓinana mo hasboore golle makko ɗen haa timma, Alla ko O Yaawuɗo Hasboore.
